description: Paste into BB's terminal from a phone or tablet. On a touch screen, BB's terminal offers no Paste, and pressing and holding it does nothing. This plugin puts Paste, a clipboard icon, in the header of the right-panel pane that shows the terminal, and a tap pastes the clipboard into that terminal the way a keyboard paste does. Where the page can't read the clipboard, as in the BB app on Android or on a plain http:// address, Paste opens a text field for the system's own Paste instead. The button shows on touch screens only.
